generation.processing: Deterministic crop, connected-alpha cleanup, Lanczos resize, PNG and lossless WebP export. Original raw files preserved.

hanging-card.integration: Paint chain behind card and overlap into the gold attachment ring. Both icon and label fit inside the brown leather. Geometry is in source pixels.

repeat.policy: Crop uses matching mid-link phases. Repeat at natural aspect ratio; overlap 1 source pixel if a seam appears. Clip the continuous chain to its required length rather than stretching individual links.

gold-chain.integration: Use two instances along the card's left/right socket x coordinates. Continue from avatar frame down to first card and from each card's bottom rings to the next top rings.

vine-terminal-left.mirrorRule: Mirror horizontally for the right terminal, reflecting x as 180-x.
vine-terminal-left.integration: Overlay around the outer end of the existing footer-wood. Keep footer-wood itself unchanged. Place the boardLeftEdge socket near the board's left end; use the mirrored counterpart at the right end. Asset contains only vines and leaves.
